description: This file implements the control functions for the Bmc2 Request Controller Object in a BroadWay Service Delivery System. It includes functions for dispatching commands and executing specific control commands such as return, transfer, and execute, optionally handling asynchronous job execution.

classes.name: PBMC2_REQ_CONTROLLER_OBJECT
classes.description: Pointer to the Bmc2 Request Controller Object, representing the core control module handling commands and its associated data.

classes.name: PBMC2_REQCO_CONTROL_COMMAND
classes.description: Pointer to a control command structure representing individual commands with CommandId and parameters.

classes.name: PBMC2_REQCO_ASYNC_JOB
classes.description: Pointer to the structure representing an asynchronous job, used for transfer and execute commands within asynchronous task handling.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS Bmc2ReqcoDispatchCommands(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PULONG pulPecStatus)
methods.description: Dispatches queued control commands, calling respective control functions based on CommandId, and handles the PEC status.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS Bmc2ReqcoDoReturn(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,SLAP_PARAMETER_LIST * param_list)
methods.description: Performs the 'return' control command; in this implementation, it simply returns success.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS Bmc2ReqcoDoTransfer(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,SLAP_PARAMETER_LIST * param_list)
methods.description: Performs the 'transfer' control command, initiating an asynchronous transfer job and waiting for its completion.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS Bmc2ReqcoDoExecute(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,SLAP_PARAMETER_LIST * param_list)
methods.description: Performs the 'execute' control command, initiating an asynchronous execution job and waiting for its completion.
